independent_source_review.review_scope: Conservative rendered-size bound and Python outputs API ownership/shape; uncommitted coordinator patch
bound_review: Every leaf bound is no larger than its emitted UTF-8 bytes; empty ParamSymbol permits zero; InputElement name+3 accounts only brackets and at least one decimal digit.

Every operation counts every child occurrence and at most one byte of its nonempty syntax; SymbolicRead counts its exact array-name/bracket overhead. Saturating cap(limit+1) cannot overstate a fitting expression.

The strict > comparison preserves exactly-at-limit strings. Existing bounded formatter remains the fallback, including underestimated oversized text. Prefix formatting and numeric/equivalence paths are unchanged.
Per-call HashMap memoization avoids exponential visits within one root without cross-call mutable cache or invalidation risks. Match is exhaustive for current ExprNode forms.
api_review: Getter returns a fresh ordinary PyList of tuples containing array-name strings and ordinary element lists of (int,str), in original order.
Each formatted Rust String is converted directly into the Python tuple and released; the arena owns all ExprIds for the result lifetime, while returned Python strings own their bytes independently.
No mutable Python result list is cached. Editing one snapshot cannot affect another; releasing AnalyzeResult cannot invalidate earlier snapshots.

Graph verdict, warning and stats handling are unchanged. Lazy formatting changes timing/resource ownership only, as documented and approved; no default text, display threshold, index, array, shape or mathematical check is removed.
limitations: This is an independent source review, not an independently compiled/tested patch. Coordinator is running cargo check and compatibility tests.
Memoization is local to each displayed root; heavily shared sub-DAGs across many fitting outputs are revisited. This is a performance limit, not weaker output accounting.
Sage still emits exactly252099659008bytes of finite text; temporary String plus final Python list memory remain substantial. Final complete gate must measure actual RSS.

memory_limit: Formatting is deferred until the existing outputs getter is read, then converted directly to Python strings. Fitting strings remain complete, so original-size Sage still needs approximately235GiB Python string payload and a measured larger budget.
